questions.question: What is IN's least favourite building?
questions.hint: The vote was almost unanimous - 92% went to the same building.
questions.solution: M-Building (92% of votes; the only other vote went to Nymble)

questions.question: Which cuisine is not the favourite cuisine of anyone in IN? (Mexican, Indian, Swedish or German)
questions.hint: IN's actual favourites were Italian (1st) and Chinese (2nd).
questions.solution: Mexican (Italian got 5 votes, Chinese 3; Indian, Swedish and German got one vote each)

questions.question: What is IN's least chosen season?
questions.hint: It only got 7%, far behind Summer (46%), Winter (30%) and Autumn (17%).

questions.question: How many people in IN have pineapple in their top 3 pizza toppings?
questions.hint: It was actually the most common pick - but it is a small group.

questions.question: What is IN's favourite hour of the day?
questions.hint: Not everyone answers during normal waking hours...
questions.solution: 3 AM (3 answers) in front of 6 PM (2 answers)

questions.question: How many steps does an average runner need to finish a marathon?
questions.hint: Recreational runners average about 170 steps per minute over 42.195 km.

questions.question: How many Big Ben towers stacked end-to-end are needed to reach the top of the Burj Khalifa?
questions.hint: Big Ben is 96 m tall, the Burj Khalifa 829.8 m.

questions.question: In terms of area, how many Spains equal Greenland?
questions.hint: Greenland covers 2,166,086 km², Spain 506,030 km².

questions.question: How many lifeboats does the largest cruise ship have?
questions.hint: The Icon of the Seas - each of its boats can hold 450 people.

questions.question: How often does the average Swedish lake fit into the biggest Swedish lake?
questions.hint: The biggest one (Vänern) covers 5,519 km²; the average lake is 0.4 km². Sweden has around 100,000 lakes.

questions.question: Who is this singer?
questions.hint: His name comes from a childhood photo of him in a grumpy bunny costume he hated.

questions.question: What animal is this?
questions.hint: It was the world's most endangered cat in the early 2000s, with only about 100 left in Spain and Portugal.

questions.question: What is this movie scene from?
questions.hint: It goes together with a Wiz Khalifa and Charlie Puth song.
questions.solution: Furious 7 - the 'See You Again' scene (Paul Walker tribute)

questions.question: What is this actor's most famous role?
questions.hint: J.K. Rowling privately told him the character's secret years before the final book came out.

questions.question: How is this used?
questions.hint: The Inca used knots tied in a decimal positional system with it.
questions.solution: A quipu - to store numbers and other values in the cords

questions.question: How many colours are traditionally said to be in a rainbow?
questions.hint: Red, orange, yellow, green, blue... and two more.
questions.solution: Seven (red, orange, yellow, green, blue, indigo and violet)

questions.question: What is the hardest natural substance on Earth?
questions.hint: It is so hard that diamonds are cut using other diamonds.

questions.question: Which animal has fingerprints so similar to humans that they can sometimes be confused? (Raccoon, Chimpanzee, Gorilla or Koala)
questions.hint: Even under a microscope, it is sometimes hard to distinguish.

questions.question: Which animal has three true hearts?
questions.hint: If you just count pumping chambers instead, the cockroach wins with 13.

questions.question: Which animal is known to have the largest eyes in the animal kingdom?
questions.hint: They can reach around 27 cm in diameter - roughly the size of a football. The biggest whale eye is only 11 cm.

questions.question: Who wrote the Odyssey?
questions.hint: An ancient Greek epic poet.
questions.solution: Homer (8th century BC; 24 books, about 12,000 lines)

questions.question: What is in the centre of the Milky Way?
questions.hint: It has a mass about 4 million times that of the Sun.
questions.solution: A massive black hole - Sagittarius A*

questions.question: How many arrondissements (districts) does Paris have?
questions.hint: Their numbers wind around the city in the shape of a snail.

questions.question: What does '67' represent in the original video of the meme?
questions.hint: It goes back to lyrics in Skrilla's song 'Doot Doot (6 7)' and was picked up in basketball - think LaMelo Ball.
questions.solution: The height of the player: 6'7'' (the '6 7 kid' in the video is Maverick)

questions.question: What is the total budget of KTH in 2025 (give or take 100 million kr)?
questions.hint: Sweden's largest technical university operates on roughly 5.5 billion.
